items.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for AI-Powered Code Review and Fixes
items.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Ship, a new tool enabling AI agents to autonomously review, fix, and approve code changes, significantly advancing automated software development.

items.title: Supertake Raises $20M to Power AI Agents for Stock Portfolio Management
items.summary: Supertake has secured $20 million in funding to develop AI agents that can transform market predictions into actionable stock portfolios, bringing advanced AI to financial investment strategies.

items.title: Jensen Huang Reinstated at Nvidia Amidst Scandal, Drawing Praise from Industry Leaders
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been reinstated following a recent scandal, a move celebrated by prominent figures like Elon Musk, signaling stability for the AI chip giant.

items.title: Google Search Introduces More Tailored, Personalized Intelligence Features
items.summary: Google is rolling out new features for Search, offering a more personalized experience that leverages AI to provide uniquely tailored results and intelligence to individual users.

items.title: OpenAI and Cisco Partner to Introduce Shirudo, Enhancing AI Security
items.summary: OpenAI and Cisco have announced a partnership to launch Shirudo, a new initiative aimed at bolstering AI security and trust in enterprise applications.

items.title: Motion Mamba 2.0: Autoregressive Diffusion Mamba for Long-Horizon Humanoid Control
items.summary: Motion Mamba 2.0 introduces an autoregressive diffusion Mamba model, significantly improving long-horizon control for humanoid robots with enhanced stability and realism.

items.title: Embo-Harness: Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness for AI Agents
items.summary: New research explores Embo-Harness, a framework designed to better understand how frontier AI models can be effectively used as policy-making agents in complex environments.

items.title: WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce
items.summary: WeMM-Ecom presents a new approach to enhance multimodal content understanding specifically tailored for WeChat's e-commerce platform, improving product discovery and user experience.

items.title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
items.summary: This paper introduces 3AGameFactory-Motion, a system for agentic rigging and generating reliable, complex motions for a wide range of 3D assets, streamlining game development and animation.

items.title: ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
items.summary: ViDecide proposes a novel method to enable video diffusion models to reason and plan actions sequentially, enhancing their ability to generate coherent and purposeful video content.

items.title: Proofreader vs. Rewriter vs. Prompt API: Testing AI Task Performance
items.summary: An article discusses the importance of testing AI tasks directly, rather than relying on demos, by comparing the performance of proofreader, rewriter, and prompt API functionalities.

items.title: WorldLeague: A New Benchmark for Physical Agency in AI
items.summary: WorldLeague introduces a new benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the physical agency of AI systems, pushing the boundaries of embodied AI research.

items.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
items.summary: AutoPILOT presents a visual agent harness that enables AI to control and interact with real-time gameplay, offering new avenues for AI in gaming and simulation.

items.title: Plan4D: Generative Plannable 4D Worlds for AI Simulation
items.summary: Plan4D introduces a framework for generating plannable 4D worlds, providing rich and dynamic environments for training and testing AI agents.

items.title: A Glimpse of Training VLMs as Foundation Models for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: This research provides insights into training Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to serve as foundational models for robotic manipulation, bridging the gap between perception and action.
